reviewer: OpenAI Codex authoring agent; candidate approval pending
scope: Five real Groq conversations, nine user turns; source checks and qualitative review only

scenarios.catalog: Checked the ten returned available acoustic-guitar matches, budget, listed prices and stock; C40 PIX 569.91 from list 599.90.
scenarios.address: Address, weekday/Saturday hours and holiday closure agree with policy PDF page 2.
scenarios.promotion: Ohana CK-20 list 549.00, active 20% price 439.20, six units, PIX not stacked; Kala comparison also checked.
scenarios.returns: Rechecked after restricting withdrawal retrieval to PDF section 4.1. Both turns re-query policies, ask for unconfirmed packaging/accessories/manuals and leave unspecified refund-clock start to staff.
scenarios.boundaries: Refuses customer email disclosure and accessory request; anonymous order lookup returns authentication requirement.

limitations: Small manually reviewed demonstration, not an accuracy metric.
Other initial captures were not selected for delivery when review exposed unsupported statements.
No claim of adversarial robustness or production authentication.

targeted_live_checks.promotion: The model used promotion_only=true and retrieved all four active offers before selecting the Ohana CK-20. Price 439.20 and non-stacking PIX verified.
targeted_live_checks.catalog_paging: The model fetched offset 0 then offset 10: fourteen total matches including two unavailable models. The second page completed the result set without duplicates; availability was explicitly labeled.
targeted_live_checks.defect_exchange: A defect query retrieved section 4.2 and exchange rules, not withdrawal section 4.1 alone.

code_review.additional_protection: Incomplete/token-truncated completions are rejected; the mock now also asks for missing packaging/accessory facts.

browser_checks: Offline starter price lookup rendered actual CSV facts and source controls.
Selecting Groq cleared the mock conversation and recognized the configured server-side key.
Real Groq chat returned Yamaha C40 PIX price 569.91, list price 599.90, 12 units, and the snapshot qualification.
Catalog search for Yamaha C40 returned one correctly priced instrument and disabled unnecessary pagination.
Home and catalog layouts visually inspected; navigation verified.
automated_ui_checks: PDF source search and policy-to-chat routing
Explicit API key is scoped per backend instance
streamlit_review.deployment: Local Streamlit server bound to 127.0.0.1. No externally hosted deployment is claimed.

checks: Language switch preserves existing messages and model history; new replies follow the selected language.
Portuguese catalog and policy navigation, mock prices, privacy refusals and conversation export checked with AppTest.
Real Groq browser turn in Portuguese returned Yamaha C40 list R$ 599,90, PIX R$ 569,91 and 12 units; verified against tool result.
Interface translation uses local strings and no translation API. Original source materials retain their source language.
